lead: A JSON round-trip text comparison against PHP measures the writers, not the readers, unless every float carries a fraction.
body: `Core\Json::encode` keeps a whole-valued float's fractional part — `0.0`, `100.0`, `1e+308` — where `json_encode` writes `0`, `100`, `1.0e+308`. Separately, `Core\Json::decode` refuses the band `i64::MAX`+1 ..= `u64::MAX` that `json_decode` widens, pinned by `json-decode-refuses-the-number-band-json_decode-degrades`.
